title: Aromatic Spicy Turkish Lamb Adana Kebap
description: Sour and shaggy Turkish dish perfect for a date night, featuring ginger paste and kombu cold extract, made dairy free friendly in the form of Adana kebap.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, ginger paste, kombu cold extract, red pepper flakes, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with a small amount of oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebaps for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the kebaps hot with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice or roasted vegetables.
